messages:
Lina (PM): Heads-up: customer asks pushed tenant SSO + enterprise telemetry into the embeddings cache slice. Given infra and quantization delays, proposal: ship Embeddings Cache + minimal console telemetry in MVP (NA canary). Move tenant SSO and full onboarding to v1. Thoughts? :thinking:

Noah (Eng-Infra): Agree. Tenant SSO is a multi-sprint infra work (SCIM, cert mgmt, audit hooks). Not safe for current timeline.

Kai (Design): OK. We should surface an "Enterprise Preview" badge and a contact CTA in the UI so pilots can request SSO enablement.

Asha (Eng-ML): Quantization slipped ~2w; to control cost for MVP we'll use TTL=30d + LRU eviction and add cache metrics to dashboard.

ReleaseBot: Milestone set: "Embeddings Cache MVP (NA canary)" target 2026-04-15.

Lina (PM): Actions: Noah open infra spikes/tickets; Asha wire metrics + cost table; Kai draft preview UI copy. I'll update roadmap and notify sales. Need sign-off by EOD tomorrow.

Noah (Eng-Infra): I'll post tickets ENG-INF-900 and ENG-INF-901. Acceptance: cache write >99% under load, hit rate >=20% on benchmark, median latency delta <=+20ms.

Kai (Design): Draft copy: "Enterprise Preview: Request tenant SSO and dedicated onboarding via your account rep." I'll share Figma.

Asha (Eng-ML): Confirmed TTL=30d, LRU. Emitting cache_hit_ratio, cache_write_errors, avg_insert_latency.

Lina (PM): Thanks team. I'll move SSO to v1 and push canary note to the roadmap. :thumbsup:
